Subject: Re: [ILUG] Broadband in Dublin

Hi,

On Mon, 08 Oct 2007, Glen Gray wrote:

> Gavin McCullagh wrote:
> >While we're on about ISPs I'll give my experience.  I deliberately went
> >with NTL back in February.  My reasons were 
> >
> >  - not wanting to pay line rental
> 
> With NTL you DO pay line rental, it's called teh Basic TV service 
> (analogue). It's quite funny that most people see this as a line rental, 
> but it is. 

I think I moreorless said this at the bottom of that email?

To be fair to NTL, eircom's line rental alone gets you nothing at all,
whereas paying for NTL's analogue tv service gives you access to 20 or so
television stations that most people wouldn't otherwise have.  You might
not want the tv channels I guess, but it's not the same as phone line
rental, where you get nothing for it, unless you then proceed to spend more
money on calls.  Given the existence of VoIP, I wouldn't intend making
landline calls.  I guess if a real equivalent IPTV service turns up, I
might feel like I'm double-paying with NTL, but for now, I think the two
services are pretty complementary.

As you say, it's understandable that the services are bundled given NTL are
not in a position to provide broadband without giving you the tv service
too.  Once they force everyone onto their unsplittable, unstable digital tv
service, that may change.  Yay progress!! :-(

Gavin
